format: NDCA Sanctioned events: devices that transmit video or images

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: While performing adjudicator duties, adjudicators may not wear or use any electronic or other device that will transmit video or images related to the judging process.

requirement: A browser ballot on a camera-equipped device is not assumed compatible; no technical control exists.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6E): judging-arrangement declaration and _compoc_blockers_judging_arrangement for the declared body. Not built.
interpretation_notes: The software cannot see what a device transmits. The coordinator's note said p.25; the footer shows p.26. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6E): a BLOCKER to activating this body profile; no test; no compliance claimed. A declaration is a self-attestation, never a verification.
